facts.fact: Dearness Relief for Central Government pensioners/family pensioners is 60% of basic pension/family pension w.e.f. 01.01.2026
facts.quote: shall be enhanced from the existing rate of 58% to 60% of the basic pension/family pension (including additional pension/additional family pension) w.e.f. 01st January, 2026.
facts.note: DoPPW OM No. 42/02/2024-P&PW(D) dated 24.04.2026, as circulated by ICMR (icmr.gov.in); doppw.gov.in served an empty page to the checker.

facts.fact: The Union Cabinet approved it on 18 April 2026 (PIB)
facts.quote: Posted On: 18 APR 2026 3:13PM by PIB Delhi

facts.fact: It was an increase of 2 percentage points over the earlier 58%
facts.quote: representing an increase of 2% over the existing rate of 58% of the Basic Pay/Pension, to compensate against price rise.

facts.fact: No DA/DR instalment for 01.07.2026 has been approved or notified yet (none as of 15 Oct 2026, still none on 28 Oct 2026)
facts.quote: 1 1/1(i)/2026-E.II(B) Revision of rates of Dearness Allowance to Central Government employees- effective from 01.01.2026. 22/04/2026
facts.note: An absence: DoE's Dearness Allowance OM list has the 22/04/2026 OM for 01.01.2026 as its newest entry, and PIB's Cabinet Decisions 2026 list (https://www.pib.gov.in/EventDetail.aspx?ID=1234&reg=3&lang=1, newest entries 14 Oct 2026) has no DA/DR item after 18 Apr 2026; pib.gov.in searches on 28 Oct 2026 found none either. Re-check on demo day.

summary: DR 60% w.e.f. 01.01.2026 (Cabinet 18 Apr 2026, +2 over 58%; DoPPW OM 24.04.2026) confirmed; still no 01.07.2026 instalment as of 28 Oct 2026.
